eps.t: The Student Council President Marries into a Family
eps.ov: A pushy woman barges into the vice chairperson's home, and he's left with no choice but to share his home.

eps.t: Student Council President and Dinner at Home
eps.ov: Against his will, their shacking up begins. Ui shows that she can wear two different hats: president and wife!

eps.t: Student Council President and the Hand-Holding Experiment
eps.ov: "Aggressive PDA disrupts campus morals!" The head prefect faces off against the student council president! Let's carry out "Love Liberation!!!"

eps.t: Shelter from the Rain Without the President
eps.ov: Love Hotel. Oh, Love Hotel. Love Hotel. Hayato and Rin go to a Love Hotel! Is that okay?! Will everything be okay?!
Making up. Yes, making up. Making up. When people make up, they usually do this and that…Is that okay?! Will everything be okay?!
Misumi-san's older sister moves…next to Hayato-kun! Will his crazy shacking up be noticed???

eps.t: The Vice President and the Two Infirmary Devils
eps.ov: "The panties and lipstick both belong to me!!!" Misumi-san, and Misumi-san closing in on Hayato-kun. Will this end well?!
"We need to talk…" Ui has a secret. Will it finally be revealed?!
Sawatari-san closes in on Hayato's house. Huh?! Now even Sawatari-san is chasing after him? What're you gonna do about it, Hayato-kun?!
"Please, let me have your daughter's hand!!!" What's going to happen now???
